title: Meta Muse exposes users' personal and business secrets when they share conversations
hook_before: Meta Muse just exposed thousands of private user conversations.
script:
Meta Muse leaks thousands of private user chats.
The flaw triggers when users share links to their chat sessions.
A single query reveals these conversations listed by their titles.
The breach includes sensitive personal details and confidential business data.
This happens because Meta failed to secure public index access.
Thousands of user sessions are currently sitting out in the open.
Would you ever trust AI with your private business documents?

editor.one_line: Strong, factual script, but the visuals are repetitive and lack dynamic variety.
script_fixes: LINE 5: Change to 'This occurred because Meta failed to configure robots.txt to block public indexing.'
visual_notes: line 1: The same robotic hand image is held for too long across multiple frames.
line 3: The visual is static; it should show a screen recording of the search query.
line 6: The visual is just text; it needs a representation of the thousands of exposed files.
